nonEolVersions.summary: The official Zig download page identifies current stable line 0.17 (latest 0.17.1 on 2026-11-02). The fixture-readme dependency genuinely executes native Zig 0.17.0 via zig build install, running std.Build dependency resolution and installing a dependency README. This proves the native build-manager point, but leaves a current 0.17 compiled-target plus runtime representative-project gap.
